builds.name: A Curse on Cavalry
builds.desc: Keen Gronnwolf+ can be refined for Defense or Resistance, to help mitigate possible damage from cavalry units. This will help against hones, though that's just about it.

builds.name: Rakish Rhajat
builds.desc: Rhajat is a very powerful green mage with similar stats to Nino and Summer Elise. You mainly want a Spd boon for the doubling potential, but an Atk boon would also be as good because it increases her overall damage. As her lowest stat, you want a Def bane. Rhajat's ideal stat line would be 36/35/37/18/24. This build is all about maximizing Rhajat's damage and doubling potential. Her main weapon, Keen Gronnwolf+, gives advantage over cavalry units. She can take out most cavalry units with exceptions such as Sigurd. Keen Gronnwolf+ can also be refined, a Spd refine, gives her +2 HP, and +2 Spd, carrying her speed to 39 (Spd Boon). Rhajat's stat line, also makes her a great canidate as a Gronnbalde+ user. Swift Sparrow 2 increases Rhajat's 35/34 offensive stat line, while not hurting her all ready poor 21/24 defensive stats. If you don't have the skill to fodder, you can budget LnD 3 but her def/res will be at 16/19. Chill Spd 3 allows her to double easier, while not getting doubled herself. Chill Res 3 allows her to output more damage. Odd Atk Wave 3, is a phenomenal skill, it gives her +6 atk buff (and her teamates) on odd turns. This buff can work with Gronnblade+. If you haven't pulled a Ishtar, Rhajat's default C, Savage Blow 3, should suffice. Aether allows Rhajat to heal and OHKO most of her opponents. Moonbow, is another option as it can proc quicker. Heavy Blade 3 procs her specials quicker, and with Odd Atk Wave 3, Heavy Blade 3 is guaranteed on odd turns. Distant Def is another option that increases her bulk by a bit. This is a very expensive build, with an SP cost of 2110 and alot of premium skills, but with investment you can turn the lovey Rhajat into a monster (A beautiful one of course) ;)

builds.name: Beautiful Perfection
builds.desc: Rhajat becomes a one-woman army. When accompanied by characters that buff her attack and speed, she is able to eliminate a significant amount of diverse opponents within the first strike. Heavy Blade 3 allows for Rhajat's Aether to kick in in roughly half the time, allowing her to heal any damage sustained during combat. By arming her with either Reposition or Swap, you enable her to either escape harm or use a squad mate as a shield, granting her another opportunity to win the battle. Of course, Vantage 3 will allow her to take out ranged attackers before they can eliminate her. This build even allows Rhajat to eliminate Hector! Sit back and enjoy the attack patterns that are as captivating, mesmerizing, and beautiful as Rhajat herself!

builds.name: Flexible Blade
builds.desc: Standard blade tome build; Fury vs Life and Death is a choice between maximum possible damage output and retaining enough sense of survivability in order to take advantage of it. Moonbow compared to Glimmer depends on how tanky the target is in notable matchups, as Moonbow performs better the more resistance the enemy has. Any Gronnblade+ build is best run with a user of forged Rogue Dagger+, Eirika, Azura (Performing Arts), or a user of forged Light Breath+, in increasing order of effectiveness. These units can be used to buff Rhajat, giving her extreme kill potential (as Gronnblade scales its damage with increased buffs) alongside very high speed with the build. Ardent Sacrifice is used to enter Desperation range, and once it's active and Rhajat is buffed there is little she can't plow through.

builds.name: Area Damage
builds.desc: The goal here is to do as much spread damage as you can so the rest of the team can clean up after her. The distant defense will help her in combat against most other magic users.
